pr_title: QL: Propagate nullability constraints across conjunctions
pr_body:
IsNull/IsNotNull inside a conjunction influences other operations done
on the same expression:

f > 10 AND f IS NULL -> f IS NULL
IFNULL(f + 1, f - 1) AND f IS NOT NULL -> f + 1 AND f IS NOT NULL

Fix #70683

issue_context.title: QL: check isnull/non-null conjunctions
issue_context.body:
Conjunctions with `IS NULL` need to propagate the null, for example: `WHERE length(f) > 10 AND f IS NULL`. 
Since `f` needs to be null, `length(f) > 10` becomes null as well so this is the same as `WHERE f IS NULL`.
Likewise for null conditionals just as `IFNULL(f, bool) AND f IS NULL` -> `boo AND f IS NULL`.

A similar approach for `IS NOT NULL` with null conditionals - `IFNULL(f + 1, f - 1) AND f IS NOT NULL` -> `f + 1 AND f IS NOT NULL`.

review_comments: Moved this code here since I found the existing loop quite inefficient - make a stream to create extraction to put into an array to pass it to a method that does another looping to do basic checks...

Isn't this also changing the way a projection is now returned when it comes to conjunctions with `NULL`able and `IS NULL` expressions? `SELECT LENGTH(NULL) > 10 AND NULL IS NULL` returns now `NULL`, after this PR I think is returning `TRUE`.
Good point - the rule is too aggressive and needs adjusting and only return null as there's another one that can pick up and reduce the null accordingly.
